steps.name: Shipping address (only present when at least one item is set to Shipping)
steps.notes: Step is collapsed until Contact info is completed, so it was not expanded in the browser. Field set and labels are now sourced from Best Buy's 2026 checkout bundle (checkout.0213d23….js content dictionary + lazy chunk checkoutV2.33050a9e….js 'address-form'; confidence: high for labels, medium for layout): First name (maxLength 50, autocomplete given-name) / Last name (50, family-name) / Address (maxLength 35, Smarty type-ahead with 'Show Suggestions' / 'Hide Suggestions' toggle; help links 'Military' and 'Non-US Address') / link 'Add Apt., Suite, Floor (optional)' revealing 'Apt., Suite, Floor (optional)' / City / State (select, placeholder 'Select') / ZIP code, then the checkboxes 'Save this address to my profile' and 'Make this my default shipping address' (signed-in only) and 'Use as billing address' (DOM id 'useAsBillingCheckbox', form field useAsBilling; only rendered while the order has no billing address yet, and its initial value for a new address is 'checked' — so billing = shipping by default; medium-high). Notices: 'Note: If you ship to a PO BOX, it can take up to a week longer to receive your item than shipping to a residential or business address.'; standardization alert 'We are unable to verify the address, please make sure address you entered is correct.' with modal 'We’re unable to verify this address.' / 'Please make sure the address you entered is correct.' → 'Update address' / 'Keep as entered'; apartment prompt 'Please check your address — The address you entered may need an apartment, unit, or suite number.' Validation strings: 'Please enter a first name.' / 'Please enter a valid first name.', 'Please enter a last name.' / 'Please enter a valid last name.', 'Please enter address.' / 'Please enter a valid address.' / 'Delivery is unavailable to P.O. Box addresses. Please enter a physical address.', 'Please enter city name.' / 'Please enter a valid city.', 'Please enter a ZIP code.' / 'Please enter a valid ZIP code.' There is NO phone field in this block (phone lives in Contact info as 'user.phone'). Older (2020-21) bot ids for the same fields: 'consolidatedAddresses.ui_address_2.{firstName,lastName,street,street2,city,state,zipcode}' and 'save-for-billing-address-ui_address_2' (the bot un-checks it before typing a separate billing address, consistent with checked-by-default). The checkout API stores the address on the item as selectedFulfillment.shipping.address = {firstName, lastName, middleInitial, street, street2, city, state, zipcode, country, dayPhoneNumber, useAddressAsBilling, giftMessageSelected} via PATCH /checkout/orders/{orderId}.

steps.name: Shipping details (only present when at least one item is set to Shipping)
options: Method rows come from items[].metadata.fulfillmentOptions.shippingDetail.levelOfServices[] (each with an id and totalPrice / offerTotalPrice; the chosen one is items[].fulfillment.levelOfService). Prices go through formatCurrency(showZeroAsFree), so a $0 row reads 'FREE'; row headings are date-based — 'Get it by {date}', 'Get it' (today), 'As soon as', 'Should ship by' — not carrier tiers. Best Buy help agrees: 'During checkout, you can choose an estimated arrival date from the options provided.' (2026 checkout bundle; medium-high)

Pre-order heading is driven by the item's displayDateType: FULFILL → 'Delivered on or shortly after Release Date' (or 'Delivered on or shortly after {date}'), IN_HAND → 'Get it by Release Date' / 'Get it by {date}', NONE → 'Release date not yet available' + 'We’ll notify you when it’s ready to ship'. The GTA VI summary line reads 'Delivered on or shortly after Release Date' (observed). IMPORTANT: the shipping-option chooser is suppressed entirely when an item has exactly one level of service and it is FREE (bundle: levelOfServices.length === 1 && price formats as 'FREE' → render null), so for this SKU the step is expected to show only the item card with 'Delivered on or shortly after Release Date' and no radio row (medium-high; step not expanded in the browser). Whether Best Buy's API also offers paid expedited levels for the pre-order — which would make rows appear — is unverified (low).

Gift options: the control is the 'Add gift options' button in the Summary panel (observed; label becomes 'Edit gift options' once saved). It opens a side sheet titled 'Gift options' (role dialog, 'Close Sheet' button) listing each item by title: shipped items get a checkbox 'Include gift message' (observed) which reveals 'Recipient email address' + 'Gift message' textarea (150 characters, 'Characters Remaining' counter); pickup items get 'Include gift receipt' with helper 'You’ll receive a gift receipt when you pick up your item.' Button 'Save gift options'; toast 'Gift options updated'. Errors: 'Please enter a gift message.', 'Edit message to remove inappropriate language.', 'Your gift message contains some special characters that we don’t recognize. Please revise your message.' No separate gift control was seen inside the collapsed step itself (medium). API: shipping item → giftMessage {emailAddress, message}; pickup item → fulfillment.giftReceipt true/false.
steps.notes: Not expanded in the browser (collapsed until Contact info + Shipping address are done). In a shipping-only cart the steps are 1 Contact info → 2 Shipping address → 3 Shipping details → 4 Payment method; when a pickup item is also in the cart, Pickup details becomes step 4 and Payment method step 5 (both observed). Summary panel already shows 'Delivered on or shortly after Release Date' for the shipped item and 'Add gift options'.

There is NO 'Me / Someone else' radio: the step heading is 'Pickup details' and it contains a 'Pickup person' row that defaults to the shopper (rendered '<name> (Name on billing address)' or 'You (Name on billing address)') plus a button (id 'changePickupPersonButton', the same 'card-call-to-action-button' style used for 'Edit' on address cards) that opens a sheet titled 'Pickup person'. Signed-in shoppers instead get a radio list: 'Name on billing address' + saved pickup persons (name, email, formatted phone, 'Edit') + 'Add new pickup person'. So the alternate person's name is TWO fields (First name / Last name); the thank-you page prints 'Make sure {{firstName}} {{lastName}} brings their photo ID and your order number to the store.' Best Buy's Store Pickup help matches: 'You'll need to provide the pickup person's name, email address and phone number.'; bring 'your government-issued photo ID' and 'Your order number'; 'We'll hold your items at the store for 5 days'; a 'Ready for pickup' email 'is a separate email from your order confirmation'; changes to the pickup person must be requested within 5 days.

steps.notes: The card form and billing block are present in the accessibility tree even while the step is collapsed, but off-canvas (not clickable) until the step opens. Consent line above the button: 'By clicking place order, you agree to Best Buy’s Terms & Privacy Policy.' Place order button is yellow (#FFE200) and sits under the running total. 2026 payment component (payment-component-forms/index-6.3.113.js): Card number — id 'number', inputmode number, maxLength 19, pattern [0-9]*, no placeholder; Expiration date — ONE input, id 'expirationDate', inputmode numeric, placeholder 'MM/YY' (observed in the DOM); Security code — id 'cvv', type tel / inputmode numeric, maxLength 4, pattern [0-9]*, placeholder 'CVV' (observed), icon aria-label 'the security code is the 3 digit CVC code found on the back of the card' (4 for Amex), screen-reader help 'Enter the 3- or 4-digit security code associated with your card.' Inline validation (one message per field, used for empty and malformed input alike — medium): 'Please enter a valid card number.', 'Please enter a valid expiration date.', 'Please enter a valid Security Code.'; card-type errors 'Card not accepted, please use a different card.' / 'This credit card type isn't supported for Marketplace items yet. Choose a different credit card to complete your purchase.'; billing: 'Please enter a first name.', 'Please enter a last name.', 'Please enter a valid address.', 'Please enter a city.', 'Please select a state.', 'Please enter a ZIP code.' Card-status banners: 'Your credit card is expired. Please use a different card or update the expiration date.', 'Your card expires in 15 days. Please use a different card or update the expiration date.' and the pre-order-specific 'Your credit card is expiring soon. Since one of your items won’t be charged until it’s available, we need you to use a different card for this order.' Saved-card CVV prompt: 'Confirm your security code' / 'Confirm and place order'; signed-in extras 'Save this card to my profile', 'Make this my preferred card'. Billing block: this is where you type a billing address when the cart is pickup-only (no shipping address — the observed session) or when the Shipping address step's 'Use as billing address' checkbox is unchecked. With that checkbox checked, the payment component (feature flag showBillingAddress) has two views — the blank BILLING_ADDRESS_FORM, or a BILLING_ADDRESS_LIST of read-only 'billing-info' address cards (radio only when >1; buttons 'Use saved address' / 'Add new' / 'Save'; edit flow 'Update Address' / 'Keep Address as Entered') — so the expected rendering is a summary card of the shipping address under the 'Billing address' heading rather than the form (medium-low; not observed). There is no separate 'Same as shipping address' checkbox inside the Payment step. Feature flags passed to the component: applePay, payWithPoints, giftCards, promoCodes, paypal, buyNowPayLater, threeDSecure, updateProfile. Older bot ids: '#optimized-cc-card-number', '#credit-card-cvv' (older '#cvv'), 'payment.billingAddress.{firstName,lastName,street,city,state,zipcode}'; place-order '.button--place-order button.btn-primary' (fast-track '.button__fast-track'); per-step Continue '.button--continue button'. Card data is sent via PUT /payment/api/v1/payment/{paymentId}/creditCard as {number (encrypted), expMonth, expYear, cvv, type, binNumber}; the order is submitted with POST /checkout/orders/{orderId}/.

quirks: The 'Pre-order' button goes straight to /cart — there is no added-to-cart modal or drawer.

Both SKUs are 'Code in Box': the box ships/pre-loads 11/12/26 (listed as 'Release Date: 11/12/2026') but the game is playable 11/19/26. No disc, no Ultimate Edition, no digital SKU on bestbuy.com; the page tells you to buy the Ultimate upgrade on the console store later.
Cart and checkout flag the SKU 'Final sale. Not returnable.' even though it is a physical box (download codes are non-returnable per Best Buy's return policy).

Fulfillment is chosen per item on the product page (radio: Pickup default / Shipping) and can be changed per line in the cart; a store is auto-picked from geolocation ('Your Store: Compton'). Before location is known the shipping ZIP defaults to 55423 (Best Buy HQ, Richfield MN); the product page then showed 'FREE shipping to 90001'.

Checkout steps change with the cart's fulfillment mix: pickup-only = Contact info → Pickup details → Payment method; shipping-only = Contact info → Shipping address → Shipping details → Payment method; mixed = Contact info → Shipping address → Shipping details → Pickup details → Payment method (all three observed). Steps are numbered and collapse/expand on one page; there is no separate review page — 'Place order' sits under the running total.

Clicking the cart's 'Checkout' button first shows the 'Sign In to Best Buy' interstitial with 'Continue as Guest'; deep-linking /checkout/r/fast-track skipped it and landed directly on the guest checkout in this session.
Tax is estimated before any address is entered (from store/ZIP): $8.60 on $79.99 (10.75%, Compton CA).
Quantity is capped at 3 per line in the cart dropdown; there is no quantity selector on the product page.

Membership prompts everywhere: search banner 'Exclusive member offer available with pre-order.', franchise hub '10x rewards', cart 'Sign in or create an account now', sign-in page 'Sign in for faster checkout.'
BNPL: Zip 'Buy now. Pay later. 4 payments starting at $20' on the product page; Zip is selected under 'Other payment options' at checkout. PayPal button appears in both cart and checkout.
Search-result tiles and the cart list lazy-load only when in the viewport (a hidden/unscrolled tab renders 'Your cart is empty' and no prices); bots need to scroll.

Store pickup: bring government-issued photo ID + order number; someone else can pick up if chosen at checkout; items held 5 days then cancelled/refunded; pre-orders 'available for pickup on or after their release date'.
Order confirmation does not equal acceptance (Terms), and Best Buy may re-preauthorize the card closer to release.

The 'billing = shipping' control is the checkbox 'Use as billing address' INSIDE the Shipping address step (2026 id 'useAsBillingCheckbox'; 2021 bot id 'save-for-billing-address-ui_address_2'; API flag useAddressAsBilling), not in the Payment step; it starts checked for a new address. A pickup-only cart has no shipping address, so the Payment step always shows the full billing form (this is what the observed session saw).

Shipping method rows are labelled by estimated arrival date ('Get it by …' / 'Delivered on or shortly after …'), listed per item from levelOfServices, and the chooser is hidden when the only option is FREE — the expected case for the GTA VI pre-order. Gift options are per item — 'Include gift message' (shipped) / 'Include gift receipt' (pickup) — in a 'Gift options' sheet opened from 'Add gift options' in the Summary. Fulfillment types in the 2026 API are shipping and inStorePickup (2021 bots: SHIPPING / IN_STORE_PICKUP).

Checkout DOM/API map from open-source Best Buy checkout bots (2020-21; still matching the 2026 labels where observed): guest button '.cia-guest-content .js-cia-guest-button'; contact 'user.emailAddress' / 'user.phone' / '#text-updates'; shipping 'consolidatedAddresses.ui_address_2.{firstName,lastName,street,street2,city,state,zipcode}' + 'save-for-billing-address-ui_address_2'; payment '#optimized-cc-card-number' / '#credit-card-cvv' / 'payment.billingAddress.{firstName,lastName,street,city,state,zipcode}'; per-step Continue '.button--continue button'; place order '.button--place-order button.btn-primary' (or '.button__fast-track'); success = URL /checkout/r/thank-you. API: PATCH /checkout/orders/{orderId} (contact, fulfillment + address), PUT /payment/api/v1/payment/{paymentId}/creditCard, POST /checkout/orders/{orderId}/ (submit). Cart: shipping radio '[name=availability-selection][id*=shipping]', ZIP input '.update-zip__zip-input', checkout '.checkout-buttons__checkout button'.

A 'Road Improvement and Food Delivery Fee $0.50' line (linking to the sales-tax help page) appeared in the checkout Summary when the shipped subtotal reached $100+ with the default 55423 (Minnesota) ZIP — Minnesota's retail delivery fee; it disappeared when only one $79.99 item was shipped. The cart shows 'Estimated Sales Tax: Calculated in checkout' once an item is set to Shipping.

Pickup person: there is no 'Me / Someone else' radio — the Pickup details step shows a 'Pickup person' row defaulting to you ('You (Name on billing address)') with a button that opens a 'Pickup person' sheet (First name / Last name / Email address / Phone number, 'Remember for future pickups', 'Confirm pickup person').

Thank-you page copy lives in the checkout bundle: 'Thanks for your order!', 'Order #: …', 'We’re sending a confirmation email to …', 'Your order will arrive by Release Date: …' / 'Your order will be ready for pickup on Release Date: … at …', plus a guest 'Create an account' checkbox 'Save your details securely for faster checkout next time.'
Card expiry is policed for pre-orders: 'Your credit card is expiring soon. Since one of your items won’t be charged until it’s available, we need you to use a different card for this order.'
A random 'We'd like your feedback!' customer-satisfaction survey dialog (Yes / No) can overlay the checkout page.
Zip messaging scales with the cart: '4 payments starting at $20' on the product page, '4 payments starting at $43.95' (2 items) and '8 payments starting at $30.00' (3 items, $239.97) in the cart.
